title: polish(app-showcase): i18n labels, My Work layout, nav IA, history via feed
body:
## Why

Polish pass on the enterprise surfaces ([#2059](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2059) / [#2060](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2060) / [#2061](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2061)) — fixing rough edges found while browser-verifying.

## What

**i18n field labels** — account / invoice / preference fields rendered as uppercased machine names (`WEBSITE` / `TAX_ID` / `THEME`) on Account 360 + Settings because the bundle only covered task/project. Added en + zh-CN labels for all three; now 网站 / 税号 / 主题 resolve.

**My Work layout**
- KPI tiles now sit in a **horizontal row** via a `flex` container. (Heads-up: the obvious `grid` type is aliased to **ObjectGrid** by plugin-grid, so it 404s with "object name required" — `flex` is the right layout primitive.)
- Sidebar uses plain `element:text` Shortcuts lines (region containers don't render nested `page:card` bodies — direct components are reliable).
- Dropped the role-gated card: page-component `visible` expressions get **no `current_user`** in the renderer eval context, so true per-role gating belongs in object/field permissions + sharing.

**History** — `record:history` reads an audit store `trackHistory` doesn't populate, so its tab was always "No history yet". Removed the redundant tab; field changes already surface in the synthesized **discussion feed** (verified live: *"Industry: Retail → Finance"*). Kept `trackHistory` on `account.status` + `industry` since that feeds those entries.

**Nav IA** — new **Workspace** group (My Work / Approvals / New Project / Settings) at the top, separate from the demo Pages gallery.

## Verification

Browser-verified on `:5181`: Account 360 + Settings show localized labels; My Work KPI row is horizontal with a rendered Shortcuts sidebar; the Workspace nav group renders; an account industry change appears in the discussion feed. `typecheck` + **20** showcase tests pass.

> Honest scope note: rendering + i18n + field-change tracking verified. Pure platform round-trips not click-through-tested (rely on standard behavior): record:details inline-save, Mark-Done execution, wizard final submit, dashboard global-filter re-scoping.
